title: 31 more libraries, 9 more mobiles added to “under threat” list
author: Ian Anstice / The Library Campaign

editorial.text: 240 libraries plus 16 mobiles currently under threat New entries today are Oxfordshire (20 out of 43 libraries). I have added two authorities where cuts were previously announced but missed from the list – Doncaster (3) – thanks to “savedoncasterlibraries” for the heads up – Bolton (up to 8) – discovered from a link found in the Doncaster article. I have amended the figure for North Yorkshire due to news article here which describes 24 library closures (already listed) plus 9 mobile libraries (not already listed). News from Bristol suggests “volunteers could be asked to run libraries”. editorial.html:
240 libraries plus 16 mobiles currently under threat

New entries today are Oxfordshire (20 out of 43 libraries). I have added two authorities where cuts were previously announced but missed from the list – Doncaster (3) – thanks to “savedoncasterlibraries” for the heads up – Bolton (up to 8) – discovered from a link found in the Doncaster article. I have amended the figure for North Yorkshire due to news article here which describes 24 library closures (already listed) plus 9 mobile libraries (not already listed). News from Bristol suggests “volunteers could be asked to run libraries”.
